issues.title: Request Changes form disappears when new message received
issues.body:
We use a popup dialog to request changes.

This dialog disappears and is reset if a new message is received.  It appears that the message can be of any type.  The dialog should stay open.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/d6753e5bd692fbffa839491706c8bb05.gif)
